missionPremise: Live SmartSite inspect is PROPERTY_ATOM_PATH=1 (X-PE-Read-Path atom-chain-warm). GET https://smartsite.cloud/api/spine/property-atoms/48021%3A34137/facets has no floodHazardFact. Cortex PR 449 adds floodHazardFact on GET /api/brokerage/v1/place/node/:id/facets at the JSON ROOT. mergeBakedBaseFacts currently copies cortex baseFacts only and returns early when facets are missing, dropping a root-only field. InspectCard has no Flood row and must not read tier2.flood. Source: _dispatches/2026-08-21_pe-flood-surface_dispatch.md, _inbox/2026-08-21_s1-flood-inspect_planner_review.json leave_behind.
completionPredicate: mergeBakedBaseFacts copies a fixture floodHazardFact from the cortex JSON ROOT onto the atom-chain payload and does not copy tier2.flood. A missing field stays missing (no invented zone). If merge returns early because facets are missing, floodHazardFact still attaches when the root carries it. InspectCard shows a Flood row for gold 48021:34137 from floodHazardFact only: present zone, typed absence, or named refusal (atom-miss / atoms-store-not-configured). Never a silent null. Never tier2.flood. Tests cover copy / non-copy / missing. Diff left uncommitted. No deploy, no apply, no Harris PBF, P:/legacy-design-tools untouched.
scopeBasis: PE BFF copy plus InspectCard row. Cortex already owns the atom read (PR 449). Live inspect is atom-chain-warm so mergeBakedBaseFacts is the live path; cortex-off strip already spreads the root and is not the live path. compare-facts floodCell (tier2.flood) is out of this card. R1 brief stays SS-W16. No new atoms. Planner commits/PR after review.

design.livePath: PROPERTY_ATOM_PATH=1 → fetchAtomChain + mergeBakedBaseFacts(adapted, cortexBody). Cortex-off strip is not live; strip already spreads root so a deployed floodHazardFact would pass through unchanged and is not invented from tier2.flood.

copyRule.onto: PeBakedFacetsResponse.floodHazardFact (same root sibling, not inside facets)
copyRule.whenMissing: leave the key absent; do not invent a zone; do not set undefined
copyRule.earlyReturn: if facets are missing, still attach root floodHazardFact when present; identity-return only when neither facets nor a valid root fact exist

design.typeGuard: copy only a plain object whose state is present | absent | refused. Reject null, strings, arrays, and snapshot-shaped {status, floodZone} objects.

card.present: Zone {floodZone}; if floodZone is null, 'Flood determination present (zone unstated)' — never invent a zone letter
card.absent: typed absence reason or kind, never silent null
card.refused: named code (atom-miss / atoms-store-not-configured / bind-conflict / malformed-atom) as FacetRow value
card.fieldMissing: CardFacet state unknown → FacetRow hides the row (honest; cortex undeployed)
card.inspect: FacetRow label Flood testid inspect-flood from baked.flood only. deriveBakedCardModel(facets, floodHazardFact). Does not call floodCell.

gold.fixture: state=present source=flood-hazard-fact floodZone=X inSpecialFloodHazardArea=false (S1 live atom, 2026-08-21)

threeQuestionGate.whatTriggersIt: local this lane; planner PR CI after review
threeQuestionGate.whatFailsWhenViolated: test fail if merge copies tier2.flood, invents a zone on a missing field, drops a root fact on the no-facets early return, or card mapper renders silent null for a named refusal
threeQuestionGate.whatBypassesIt: compare-facts.floodCell still reads tier2.flood (out of InspectCard this pass). A second client that ignores floodHazardFact. Undeployed cortex (field absent on live GET until PR 449 serves).

mergeCopiesRootFact.falsifier: field absent after merge, or floodZone not X

mergeDoesNotCopyTier2Flood.expect: 'floodHazardFact' not in merged when only tier2.flood is present, even if that flood is AE/FLOODWAY
mergeDoesNotCopyTier2Flood.falsifier: any floodHazardFact whose zone/status came from tier2.flood

missingStaysMissing.expect: 'floodHazardFact' in merged === false on today's bakedCortexBody
missingStaysMissing.falsifier: key present with any value including null

earlyReturnStillAttaches.expect: mergeBakedBaseFacts(adapted, { floodHazardFact: fixture }) attaches the fact even with no facets key
earlyReturnStillAttaches.falsifier: returns adapted unchanged (same reference or missing field)

cardNamedRefusalNeverSilentNull.expect: atom-miss and atoms-store-not-configured produce FacetRow-renderable absent values equal to the code
cardNamedRefusalNeverSilentNull.falsifier: value null, or row hidden while the fact was refused

adversarialReview.objection: Putting floodHazardFact inside facets would ride the existing merge without a new root field.
adversarialReview.response: Cortex PR 449 attaches the field on the JSON ROOT (brokerageNodeFacets.ts res.json sibling of facets/tier2). Copying from a nested place that cortex does not write would look like a merge win while remaining starved. Root-to-root.

adversarialReview.objection: compare-facts.floodCell already renders flood from tier2.flood; reuse it on InspectCard.
adversarialReview.response: SS-W16 plus WDLL item 3 forbid snapshot flood as the inspect value. floodCell is the retired vocabulary. New mapper from floodHazardFact only.

adversarialReview.objection: If cortex is undeployed, showing a Flood row as 'not verified here' claims an honest absence that is really an undeployed field.
adversarialReview.response: Missing field → unknown → FacetRow hides the row. A named refusal is only rendered when cortex sent state=refused.
adversarialReview.disposition: Hide when absent-from-wire; name when refused-on-wire.

secondMechanism.claim: Atom-chain already carries flood-hazard-fact in chain.atoms so merge is unnecessary.
secondMechanism.rejectedBecause: adaptAtomChainToBakedFacets maps zoning/setback/envelope only (atom-chain-to-facets.ts). Live GET on smartsite.cloud has no floodHazardFact. S1 planner review named this exact drop.
